caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
relations: The rower exerts force on the oar handle, pulling it backward through the air.
The oar blade, submerged in the lake, moves upward and exits the water surface.
Water clinging to the blade's surface detaches due to inertia and gravity, falling back into the lake.
The oar continues moving through the air until the rower releases it or begins the next stroke.
